# telemt

[telemt](https://github.com/telemt/telemt) is an MTProto proxy for Telegram, written in Rust by the Telemt maintainers; the node's MTProto backend runs it as a separate process. The node image ships the unmodified upstream release binary of telemt 3.5.14 (`telemt-x86_64-linux-musl.tar.gz` or `telemt-aarch64-linux-musl.tar.gz`, checked against the SHA256 values pinned in the node `Makefile`), and its source code and build instructions are at https://github.com/telemt/telemt/tree/3.5.14. telemt is licensed under the TELEMT License 3.3, Copyright (c) 2026 Telemt: `LICENSE` is the root license file of the 3.5.14 tag and `TELEMT-LICENSE.en.md` is the English text that file names as canonical (`docs/LICENSE/TELEMT-LICENSE.en.md`), both copied verbatim. The PasarGuard node is not a Telemt release and is not endorsed by the Telemt maintainers.
